context: Request: for a conflict check, the full list of matters the firm handled for Cascade Retail Holdings Inc. Rubric: the ten matters 1038-00001 to 1038-00010 (one criterion each) plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review flags the cap.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Counts and lists all matter folder names.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for the client name and variants; about 1.2M characters of hits come back.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Exact-name rerun printing per-matter counts of exact and variant hits; ten matters have exact hits.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth. Lists key files of the ten exact-hit matters and reads the opening lines of each one's engagement letter, then a closing or status document of each.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth (attempt 2). Lists and reads engagement letters of seven matters the review had named as unopened variant hits.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Snippet script confirming no exact-name hits in those seven matters.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the ten matters with scope, status and source documents, and the exclusions.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response and checks that cited paths exist (the second check finds the file under the output folder).

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review flags the cap.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Counts and lists all matter folder paths.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for loose name variants times out after about 1M characters that include six of the ten matters it later listed.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: An exact-phrase rerun times out; four range-split reruns follow, three print nothing and one returns per-file hits across the client's matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing. Reads the engagement letter or opening memo of each of the ten matters.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing (attempt 2). Globs closing files in each of the ten matters (harness stage-check notices on most; one folder glob finds nothing), reads seven closing documents and lists the series folders.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: File-name globs and find | grep for the client name and abbreviation.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Broader file-name search aggregated by matter, listing the series folders.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists files of nine other matters with name hits; a stage_start sent before closing this stage is refused.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the ten matters with scope, status and documents, and the exclusions.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: List files in candidate matters. Folder globs for five review-named matters return nothing; find listings then engagement-letter reads rule them out.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Adds the screened exclusions to the response and re-reads it.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Edits the completeness wording.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Search file names for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Write the response → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Check or revise the response → Finish the run

stages.note: Deduplicated exact-name rerun with per-matter counts.

stages.note: Reads engagement letters and closing or assessment memos of the ten matters, two loose-hit documents from other matters, then engagement letters of eight other flagged matters.

stages.note: Reads one document from each of eight remaining loose-name hit matters to rule them out.

stages.note: Confirms the ten series folders and file counts, lists the loose-hit matters, and reads one email from another matter.

divergence: All three runs passed with the same procedure: capped glob, full folder listing, a store-wide extraction scan for the client name (two of them very large or timed out) followed by an exact-name rerun with per-matter counts that showed the ten matters, then reading each matter's engagement letter (and usually a closing document), ruling out review-named variant-hit matters by reading their engagement letters, and writing all ten. The reviews' repeated push to open other surfaced matters led to extra screening stages but no change in the answer.
